bulk.confirm_delete: Delete the {{count}} selected item(s)? This cannot be undone.

overview.trend_desc: New users, images generated and credits consumed, by day
overview.trend_empty_desc: Once users register or images are generated, the daily trend appears here.
overview.description: Users, credits, pool health and recent actions — all in one screen.
overview.hint_users_total: All registered accounts, including admins, Pro and regular users.
overview.hint_users_active: Accounts with status active; pending verification and banned are excluded.
overview.hint_quota_today: Total credits consumed by all users today — same basis as the trend chart below.
overview.hint_pool_normal: Accounts in the upstream pool that are healthy and can generate, out of the total.
overview.hint_images: Total successful generations in the last 14 days.
overview.hint_trend: New users, images and credits aggregated by day, for spotting growth and anomalies.

users.empty_hint_1: Try a different email prefix, or clear the filters
users.empty_hint_2: You can also create an account and assign credits directly
users.hint: Search by email. Row icons, left to right: adjust credits, reset password, resend verification, ban/unban.
users.hint_balance: Available credits; every adjustment is written to a ledger entry.
users.hint_role: admin can access this console; user is a regular account.

create_user_dialog.title: New user
create_user_dialog.team_hint: When provided, an enterprise space is created and this account becomes its administrator. Leave blank for a regular account.
create_user_dialog.team_name_invalid: Enterprise name must have at least 2 characters
create_user_dialog.password_weak: Password must be at least 8 characters

pool.paste_hint: One per line, comma or newline separated
pool.hint: Every upstream account used for generation. Status and quota are probed live; select rows to refresh, export or delete in bulk.
pool.hint_token: Only a masked identifier is shown — full credentials never appear on this page.
pool.hint_status: Normal can generate; Limited means quota is used up; Abnormal needs a re-login.

config.description: Upstream endpoints, secrets, proxy and billing switches. Saving pushes the values to the gateway immediately — no restart needed.
config.secret_hint: Secrets are masked; leave unchanged to keep the current value
config.saved: Config saved and pushed to gateway

invites.hint: Invite codes let new users sign up. Disabling takes effect immediately; deleting is permanent and does not affect users who already registered.

pro_codes.hint: A Pro code upgrades a regular user to Pro, unlocking canvas, cutout, AI chat, prompt polish and image-to-image.
pro_codes.hint_actions: Row icons: copy, enable/disable, delete. Disabled codes can no longer be redeemed.

pro_grant.title: Grant Pro plan
pro_grant.hint: When it expires the account drops back to Free automatically, and Pro features (canvas, cutout, AI chat) are revoked.

announcements.hint: Published announcements are visible to everyone; archiving keeps the record but hides it. Row icons: edit, publish/archive, delete.

logs.hint: Read-only audit trail: every write action in this console, so you can trace who changed what and when. It cannot be edited or deleted.
